alex: Repro summary: edge sample fails after bundling. Vite/webpack/rollup sometimes resolve to our CJS artifact, producing `require(...)` in worker bundles -> ReferenceError in edge runtimes.

sophia: Quick repro: clone sample-edge-sdk-min, npm ci, npm run build:vite, npx miniflare dist/worker.js -> ReferenceError: require is not defined.

mike: Root causes we hit: (1) package has main/module but no conditional exports, (2) ESM build sometimes includes CJS interop helpers (babel/rollup-commonjs), (3) TS emit config can force `require` nodes.

alex: Minimal sample handler: `import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/sdk'; export default async (req) => new Response((await Redwood.generate({prompt:'hi'})).text);` After build some chunks inline `require('crypto')`.

sophia: Temporary workaround for customers: Vite alias to the ESM bundle: `resolve: { alias: { '@redwood-inference/sdk': '/node_modules/@redwood-inference/sdk/dist/esm/index.js' } }`. Not ideal but confirms entry selection.

mike: Proposed fixes: add `exports` map with import/require, publish clean `dist/esm` with pure ESM (no commonjs wrapper), keep `dist/cjs` for Node, add CI smoke matrix that builds samples with vite/webpack/rollup and runs them under miniflare. Also add `grep -R "\brequire\(" dist/esm || exit 1` check in release.

build-bot: CI sdk-edge-smoke failed -> https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/edge-smoke/501 (ReferenceError: require is not defined).

sophia: I'll open the PR to add exports + smoke CI. Mike can handle TS/rollup changes to produce pure ESM. Alex will draft support note with temporary workarounds.

mike: One extra: include subpath export for "./package.json" so bundlers don't attempt to read package root wrong. Also keep `module` field for older bundlers.

alex: Thanks team. Adding this as a 2-day bugfix in the sprint and tagging eng-plat for visibility. :+1:
